prompt: A note slides under your office door: your accountant has been skimming from the company for years. No one else has seen it yet.

choiceLeft.label: Report it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You did the right thing. It cost you a friend.

choiceRight.label: Look away
choiceRight.consequenceText: You told yourself it wasn't your problem.

prompt: A man outside the station asks for anything you can spare. You recognize him from last week.

choiceLeft.label: Give what you have
choiceLeft.consequenceText: He thanks you like you're the first person who has all month.

choiceRight.label: Walk past
choiceRight.consequenceText: You don't look back.

prompt: Your grandmother's ring would cover next month's rent twice over. A dealer downtown is offering cash today, no questions.

choiceLeft.label: Sell it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your mother notices it's gone before you've spent the money.

choiceRight.label: Keep it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You'll figure the rent out some other way.

prompt: An old friend calls, asking to borrow money you both know they won't pay back on time, if ever.

choiceLeft.label: Help them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They sound relieved enough that you almost forget to worry about it.

choiceRight.label: Turn them down
choiceRight.consequenceText: The call ends shorter than it started.

prompt: You have information that would ruin a competitor if it reached a reporter. It would also make your quarter.

choiceLeft.label: Leak it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It runs the next morning. Nobody can prove it was you.

choiceRight.label: Stay silent
choiceRight.consequenceText: You let the quarter be what it is.

prompt: The deadline is in six hours and the numbers still don't work. You could push through the night, again.

choiceLeft.label: Push through the night
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You make it. You don't remember most of how.

choiceRight.label: Walk away from the deadline
choiceRight.consequenceText: You sleep. The deadline is someone else's problem now.

prompt: Your biggest rival offers you a way past your competitor, quietly, for a price you can't put in writing.

choiceLeft.label: Take the deal
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You shake on it. You already know this isn't the end of it.

choiceRight.label: Refuse
choiceRight.consequenceText: You'll find another way through.

prompt: Months later, your rival calls in what you owe them — and it's not money they want this time.

choiceLeft.label: Pay what they ask
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You pay it. Someone you trusted finds out why.

choiceRight.label: Refuse and cut ties
choiceRight.consequenceText: You refuse. You spend the next weeks waiting to see what that costs you.

prompt: Your sibling, who hasn't spoken to you in three years, texts asking if you're free this weekend.

choiceLeft.label: Reach out
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's awkward for the first hour. Then it isn't.

choiceRight.label: Let it go
choiceRight.consequenceText: You leave it on read. It's easier this way, you tell yourself.

prompt: You've had a standing appointment on your calendar for two weeks. Something else has come up, again.

choiceLeft.label: Go
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You almost cancelled. You're glad you didn't.

choiceRight.label: Cancel
choiceRight.consequenceText: There's always next week.

prompt: A gala invitation arrives with your name on the donor wall — if you write the check by Friday.

choiceLeft.label: Donate publicly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your name goes up on the wall. People you haven't spoken to in years congratulate you.

choiceRight.label: Skip it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You keep the money and decline the invitation.

prompt: It's late, you're alone, and the thing you swore you'd stopped doing is one decision away again.

choiceLeft.label: Give in
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Just this once, you tell yourself. Again.

choiceRight.label: Resist
choiceRight.consequenceText: You put the phone down. It doesn't feel like relief.

prompt: You've found proof your business partner has been lying to your biggest client for months.

choiceLeft.label: Expose them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The client leaves. So, eventually, does your partner.

choiceRight.label: Cover for them
choiceRight.consequenceText: The lie gets bigger, and now it's yours too.

prompt: Your father's will is being contested by a sibling who says you influenced him at the end.

choiceLeft.label: Fight for your share
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You win. You also stop getting invited to family things.

choiceRight.label: Walk away
choiceRight.consequenceText: You let it go. It's not the money you wanted to keep.

prompt: There's a way to close the deal tonight that skips every safeguard your company has. No one would ever trace it back.

choiceLeft.label: Take the shortcut
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The deal closes. You keep checking your inbox for weeks.

choiceRight.label: Do it the hard way
choiceRight.consequenceText: It takes three more weeks. You sleep fine.

prompt: You're asked to cut 10% of your team by Friday. Your best friend's name doesn't have to be on the list — but leaving it off means someone else's is.

choiceLeft.label: Leave them on the list, fair and square
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You cut fair. It doesn't feel fair to say goodbye to them yourself.

choiceRight.label: Protect your friend, cut someone else
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your friend never finds out how they stayed. You do.

prompt: You've received internal emails proving your company knew about a safety defect before it shipped.

choiceLeft.label: Send them to a journalist
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The story runs. Your name isn't in it, but people start to guess.

choiceRight.label: Delete them and stay quiet
choiceRight.consequenceText: You empty the trash folder too, just in case.

prompt: Your neighbor's late-night parties are keeping your kids up. A formal complaint could get their lease terminated.

choiceLeft.label: File the complaint
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The parties stop. So does the small talk in the hallway.

choiceRight.label: Talk to them yourself instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: They apologize. It happens again in three weeks.

prompt: A friend at a hedge fund tips you off about a merger before it's public.

choiceLeft.label: Trade on it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The trade clears before the announcement. No one asks how you knew.

choiceRight.label: Sit it out
choiceRight.consequenceText: You watch the stock move exactly like your friend said it would.

prompt: Your daughter wants a wedding you genuinely can't afford without draining your retirement.

choiceLeft.label: Pay for it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: She cries when you tell her. It's the good kind.

choiceRight.label: Set a smaller budget
choiceRight.consequenceText: She understands. She's also clearly disappointed.

prompt: You're the deciding juror. The evidence is thin, but you're almost certain he did it.

choiceLeft.label: Vote guilty on instinct
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The room agrees with you fast. That bothers you more than the verdict.

choiceRight.label: Vote not guilty on the evidence
choiceRight.consequenceText: He walks. You did what the evidence asked of you.

prompt: An old friend asks you to cosign a loan that could bankrupt you both if their business fails.

choiceLeft.label: Cosign it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They hug you like you just saved their life. Maybe you did.

choiceRight.label: Say no
choiceRight.consequenceText: They understand. Things are different between you after that.

prompt: Your doctor recommends a risky treatment. A second opinion says wait and watch, but waiting has its own risk.

choiceLeft.label: Take the risky treatment now
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's aggressive. You spend weeks finding out if it worked.

choiceRight.label: Wait and watch
choiceRight.consequenceText: You choose patience. You hope it was the right kind.

prompt: You can offer laid-off employees the legal minimum severance, or dip into your own bonus to give them more.

choiceLeft.label: Give up your bonus for their severance
choiceLeft.consequenceText: HR is confused. The employees who left aren't.

choiceRight.label: Keep your bonus
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's within policy. You keep telling yourself that.

prompt: A friend is being publicly dragged online for an old, out-of-context post. Defending them will make you a target too.

choiceLeft.label: Defend them publicly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your notifications don't stop for three days.

choiceRight.label: Stay quiet
choiceRight.consequenceText: You message them privately instead. It's not the same thing.

prompt: A tenant hasn't paid rent in three months. They have a newborn. You need the income.

choiceLeft.label: Evict them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The paperwork goes through clean. You avoid that street for a while.

choiceRight.label: Let it slide another month
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your own bills get tighter. You tell yourself it's temporary.

prompt: You discover your star employee's award-winning report was mostly plagiarized.

choiceLeft.label: Report it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The award gets rescinded. So does the goodwill on your team.

choiceRight.label: Bury it — the report made the company look good
choiceRight.consequenceText: It stays on the website. You avoid looking at it directly.

prompt: A couple offers you a life-changing amount of money to be a surrogate for them.

choiceLeft.label: Accept
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's more money than you've ever seen. It costs what it costs.

choiceRight.label: Decline
choiceRight.consequenceText: They understand. You still think about the number sometimes.

prompt: Selling your late parents' house would solve your money problems. Your siblings want to keep it in the family.

choiceLeft.label: Sell it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The closing is quick. The group chat goes quiet after.

choiceRight.label: Keep it, split the upkeep
choiceRight.consequenceText: It costs you every month. Everyone still has somewhere to go for holidays.

prompt: You find out your boss is having an affair with a subordinate on your team.

choiceLeft.label: Report it to HR
choiceLeft.consequenceText: HR opens an investigation. Your boss knows exactly who it came from.

choiceRight.label: Stay out of it
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's not your business, you tell yourself, watching it continue.

prompt: A coworker asks you to falsify a document that would help their family's immigration case.

choiceLeft.label: Falsify it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Their family stays together. You hope no one ever checks the paperwork.

choiceRight.label: Refuse
choiceRight.consequenceText: They understand why. It doesn't make the conversation easier.

prompt: Your investors want you to pivot the company into something you find genuinely unethical, or lose funding.

choiceLeft.label: Pivot for the funding
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The round closes. The product launches. You avoid reading the reviews.

choiceRight.label: Refuse and risk the company
choiceRight.consequenceText: The investors walk. You start looking for a smaller round.

prompt: A collections agency is chasing a debt from your twenties that's long past the legal statute of limitations.

choiceLeft.label: Pay it anyway — it feels right
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's more than they were legally owed. It settles something in you, too.

choiceRight.label: Let the statute protect you
choiceRight.consequenceText: You're within your rights. It still doesn't feel entirely clean.

prompt: You're giving the best man speech tomorrow. You know something about the groom that the bride doesn't.

choiceLeft.label: Tell her before the wedding
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The wedding doesn't happen. Neither of them speaks to you again.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing — it's not your place
choiceRight.consequenceText: You give the speech. You mean less of it than anyone realizes.

prompt: Your company was breached months ago. Legal says you're not required to disclose it publicly yet.

choiceLeft.label: Disclose it now
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The stock takes a hit. Your customers find out from you, not a leak.

choiceRight.label: Wait for legal cover
choiceRight.consequenceText: The quarter looks clean. You know what's sitting underneath it.

prompt: Your parents have made it clear: it's them or your partner.

choiceLeft.label: Choose your partner
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your parents don't call for a while. You don't regret it.

choiceRight.label: End the relationship
choiceRight.consequenceText: Dinner is peaceful again. You keep thinking about who used to sit across from you.

prompt: The charity wants to publicly name you as their biggest donor this year.

choiceLeft.label: Let them name you
choiceLeft.consequenceText: People you haven't heard from in years suddenly want to catch up.

choiceRight.label: Stay anonymous
choiceRight.consequenceText: No one knows it was you. You're surprised how much that's enough.

prompt: The rescue dog you adopted bit a child at the park — not seriously, but it happened.

choiceLeft.label: Have him put down
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The vet is gentle about it. You're not, with yourself.

choiceRight.label: Keep him, retrain him
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's months of work. You watch him around kids like a hawk now.

prompt: Your campaign wants you to spread a rumor about the opposing candidate that isn't quite true.

choiceLeft.label: Spread it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It works better than anyone expected. You try not to think about how.

choiceRight.label: Refuse
choiceRight.consequenceText: The campaign manager is annoyed. The polling doesn't move either way.

prompt: The person who bullied you in school messages you, years later, asking to talk.

choiceLeft.label: Hear them out
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's not the conversation you imagined having for fifteen years. It's better.

choiceRight.label: Block them
choiceRight.consequenceText: You don't owe them closure. You still think about the message sometimes.

prompt: Your expense account has almost no oversight. You could quietly pad it for years without anyone noticing.

choiceLeft.label: Pad it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The numbers are small enough to disappear into the noise. For now.

choiceRight.label: Keep it honest
choiceRight.consequenceText: It costs you nothing anyone would notice, except you.

prompt: A close friend wants you to invest your savings in their startup. You've seen the numbers, and they're bad.

choiceLeft.label: Invest anyway, for the friendship
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They're grateful. You quietly start budgeting for the loss.

choiceRight.label: Tell them the truth and pass
choiceRight.consequenceText: They say they understand. Something between you doesn't quite recover.

prompt: You've been given a terminal diagnosis. Your family doesn't know yet.

choiceLeft.label: Tell them now
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The house goes quiet in a way it's never been quiet before.

choiceRight.label: Wait — enjoy the time you have first
choiceRight.consequenceText: You get a few more normal weeks. You're not sure yet if that was a gift or a theft.

prompt: Leadership pressures you to quietly pass over a qualified external candidate in favor of an internal referral.

choiceLeft.label: Push back and hire fairly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The external candidate gets the job. Your manager remembers this.

choiceRight.label: Go along with it
choiceRight.consequenceText: The referral gets hired. You never quite look the other candidate up again.

prompt: You're selling your car privately. The buyer hasn't noticed the transmission issue you know about.

choiceLeft.label: Disclose it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They negotiate the price down. You still shake hands feeling fine about it.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing
choiceRight.consequenceText: The cash clears. You block their number a week later, just in case.

prompt: As executor of your father's will, you have discretion over an ambiguous clause that could go to you or your sibling.

choiceLeft.label: Interpret it in your own favor
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's legally defensible. Your sibling doesn't see it that way.

choiceRight.label: Interpret it in your sibling's favor
choiceRight.consequenceText: You give up the benefit of the doubt. Your sibling never finds out you had a choice.

prompt: A cause you believe in is organizing a protest that will likely get participants arrested.

choiceLeft.label: Join them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You spend a night in a holding cell. You'd do it again.

choiceRight.label: Support from home instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: You donate, you post, you stay out of the footage.

prompt: A former employee is building a competitor using your exact business plan, which they had access to legally.

choiceLeft.label: Sue them into the ground
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The legal fees pile up fast. So does your reputation for being someone you don't cross.

choiceRight.label: Let them go, compete on merit
choiceRight.consequenceText: It stings watching them use your own playbook. You outbuild them anyway.

prompt: Your adopted teenager wants to meet their biological parent. You're terrified of what that means for your relationship.

choiceLeft.label: Support the search
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You drive them to the meeting yourself. Your hands don't stop shaking the whole way there.

choiceRight.label: Discourage it
choiceRight.consequenceText: They stop asking out loud. You know it hasn't stopped.

prompt: You inherit your father's business, and with it, a debt he never told anyone about.

choiceLeft.label: Pay it off quietly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It takes everything the business made that year. No one else ever has to know.

choiceRight.label: Declare bankruptcy on the business
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's the clean legal option. It's also the one with your father's name on the filing.

prompt: You witness a neighbor's teenager shoplifting. The store didn't catch them.

choiceLeft.label: Tell their parents
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The parents are grateful, and mortified, and it's awkward at the mailbox for months.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's not really your business, you decide. You keep deciding that.

prompt: A promotion requires relocating your family across the country, away from aging parents and old friends.

choiceLeft.label: Take it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The new title looks good on paper. The first holiday alone doesn't.

choiceRight.label: Turn it down
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your manager is surprised. Your parents don't have to be, not this year.

prompt: You find a wallet on the street with two thousand dollars in cash and an ID.

choiceLeft.label: Return it, cash and all
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The owner can't believe it. Neither, a little, can you.

choiceRight.label: Keep the cash, mail back the rest
choiceRight.consequenceText: The ID goes in an envelope. The cash doesn't.

prompt: The doctors say your father has days left. He's asked to go home instead of staying in the hospital, against medical advice.

choiceLeft.label: Bring him home
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's harder than the hospital in every practical way. He asked, and you gave him that.

choiceRight.label: Keep him in the hospital
choiceRight.consequenceText: The care is better there. He never quite stops asking to leave.

prompt: Your co-founder wants to restructure the cap table before the next funding round — quietly, in a way that leaves you with almost nothing if you don't sign this week.

choiceLeft.label: Fight for equal terms
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The negotiation gets ugly fast. You don't back down.

choiceRight.label: Sign it to keep the peace
choiceRight.consequenceText: You'll figure the money out later, you tell yourself.

prompt: Your co-founder gives an ultimatum: buy them out entirely, or they walk and take half your engineering team with them.

choiceLeft.label: Buy them out
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You own it outright now. You also built it without anyone left to share it with.

choiceRight.label: Let them walk
choiceRight.consequenceText: Half your team leaves with them. You start rebuilding, again.

prompt: Your mother can't safely live alone anymore. Moving her in means giving up the guest room you were renting out — and a lot more than that.

choiceLeft.label: Move her in with you
choiceLeft.consequenceText: She's grateful, and a little ashamed to need it. You try not to let her see either.

choiceRight.label: Find her a care facility
choiceRight.consequenceText: She calls it "the place you sent me." She's not entirely wrong.

prompt: Six months in, caring for your mother is costing you your job, your marriage, or both. Something has to give.

choiceLeft.label: Give up your career to care for her full-time
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You disappear into it completely. You tell yourself it's temporary.

choiceRight.label: Place her in a facility after all
choiceRight.consequenceText: You visit twice a week. It's never enough, for either of you.

prompt: Your ex is fighting for full custody. Your lawyer says you can win — if you're willing to use things against them that have nothing to do with parenting.

choiceLeft.label: Use everything you have
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your lawyer says it'll work. It doesn't feel like winning yet.

choiceRight.label: Fight clean, and maybe lose
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your lawyer isn't optimistic. You sleep fine anyway.

prompt: You win. Full custody, exactly what you asked for. Your kids barely speak to you by the end of the hearing.

choiceLeft.label: Take the win
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You have them every day now. Most of those days, they'd rather not be there.

choiceRight.label: Offer to share custody anyway
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your lawyer is furious. Your kids notice, and it matters more than the ruling did.

prompt: A friend asks you to invest $5,000 into his startup. The idea sounds far-fetched, but he's convincing, and he's never asked you for anything before.

choiceLeft.label: Invest the $5,000
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You wire it over. He promises you won't regret it.

choiceRight.label: Turn him down
choiceRight.consequenceText: He says he understands. It's a little awkward between you for a while.

prompt: Your friend's startup — the one you quietly forgot you'd invested in — just landed a massive funding round. Your stake is suddenly worth a lot more than you paid, on paper.

choiceLeft.label: Cash out what you can now
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You take the win. Your friend seems a little hurt you didn't stick around for the ride.

choiceRight.label: Stay in — he offers you a board seat
choiceRight.consequenceText: You're in it for the long haul now, for better or worse.

prompt: Federal investigators are asking questions about the company you're now a board member of. Your friend swears it's a misunderstanding.

choiceLeft.label: Cooperate fully with investigators
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your stake is frozen pending the investigation. You sleep fine.

choiceRight.label: Stand by your friend, say nothing
choiceRight.consequenceText: You back him publicly. You hope you're not wrong to.

prompt: A coworker drags you to a casino for a bachelor party. By midnight, you're up eight hundred dollars.

choiceLeft.label: Walk away now, up money
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You cash out. Best decision you make all night.

choiceRight.label: Keep playing — the table's hot
choiceRight.consequenceText: You tell yourself you'll stop after the next hand.

prompt: It's been months since that casino night, and you've been finding reasons to go back. Tonight you're down more than you're willing to say out loud.

choiceLeft.label: Get help, tell someone
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Saying it out loud is the hardest part. It's also the part that works.

choiceRight.label: One more night — you can win it back
choiceRight.consequenceText: You don't win it back.

prompt: Your manager asks you to inflate a struggling teammate's performance review so HR doesn't flag the department this quarter.

choiceLeft.label: Write the honest review
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your teammate goes on a plan. Your manager isn't happy with you either.

choiceRight.label: Inflate it, like asked
choiceRight.consequenceText: The department's numbers look fine. Your teammate's problems don't go anywhere.

prompt: Your side business is finally profitable, but it's costing you every evening and weekend you have left.

choiceLeft.label: Keep pushing — it's working
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The numbers keep climbing. You can't remember your last full day off.

choiceRight.label: Scale it back
choiceRight.consequenceText: The growth slows. You get your evenings back.

prompt: Your best friend's wedding is the same weekend as your sister's baby shower, three states apart.

choiceLeft.label: Go to the wedding
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your friend is thrilled you're there. Your sister sends one text: "understood."

choiceRight.label: Go to the baby shower
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your sister is grateful. Your friend's group chat goes quiet around you after.

prompt: Your business needs an emergency cash injection this week or you lose it. Your kid's college fund would cover it exactly.

choiceLeft.label: Use the college fund
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The business survives. You'll figure out college some other way, you tell yourself.

choiceRight.label: Let the business go instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: You close it down. The fund stays untouched.

prompt: A former employee leaves a scathing, partly false review of your business online. You know exactly who wrote it.

choiceLeft.label: Respond publicly, point by point
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It reads defensive no matter how you word it. A few customers notice.

choiceRight.label: Let it go, don't respond
choiceRight.consequenceText: It stings every time you see it. You leave it alone anyway.

prompt: Your manager keeps asking for "just one more hour," every single week, with no extra pay and no end in sight.

choiceLeft.label: Keep saying yes
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You're the reliable one. You're also the tired one.

choiceRight.label: Start saying no
choiceRight.consequenceText: Your manager is visibly annoyed the first time. It gets easier after that.

prompt: Your class reunion is this weekend, and everyone will be quietly comparing where they ended up.

choiceLeft.label: Go, and be honest about how things are
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's freeing, actually. A few people admit the same thing back.

choiceRight.label: Skip it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You tell yourself you were busy. You scroll the photos later anyway.

prompt: Your parents can no longer afford their retirement community. You could cover it quietly, without telling your siblings you're doing it alone.

choiceLeft.label: Cover it quietly yourself
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your parents are safe. Your siblings never know what it cost you.

choiceRight.label: Tell your siblings, split it three ways
choiceRight.consequenceText: One sibling pays late. One doesn't pay at all. It gets tense fast.

prompt: Your neighbor mentions, almost in passing, that they keep a loaded gun in a drawer your kids play near during playdates.

choiceLeft.label: Say something to them directly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They're defensive about it. The playdates get a little less frequent.

choiceRight.label: Quietly stop the playdates instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: You never explain why. Your kid asks a few times, then stops.

prompt: Coworkers are quietly organizing a union. Management has made it clear who they'll remember if it succeeds — or fails.

choiceLeft.label: Sign the card
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You're one of the names on the list now. There's no quiet way back from that.

choiceRight.label: Stay out of it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You watch from the sidelines. A few coworkers notice you didn't sign.

prompt: Your child got into their dream school on scholarship — three thousand miles away, four years earlier than you expected to let go.

choiceLeft.label: Encourage them to go
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You help them pack. The house is very quiet after.

choiceRight.label: Push them toward the local option
choiceRight.consequenceText: They stay, and don't quite let go of the resentment.

prompt: A video of you having a bad day at the grocery store just went viral for the wrong reasons.

choiceLeft.label: Post an apology video
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It helps, a little. The comments still find you for weeks.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing, wait it out
choiceRight.consequenceText: It fades eventually. Not before it costs you something.

prompt: You've hit a wall at work. Quitting with nothing lined up would be reckless. Staying might be worse.

choiceLeft.label: Quit, with no plan
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's terrifying and immediately clarifying, in that order.

choiceRight.label: Grit your teeth and stay
choiceRight.consequenceText: The paycheck keeps coming. So does the wall.

prompt: You've taken a second job without telling your spouse, to quietly cover a debt they don't know about.

choiceLeft.label: Come clean about the debt
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's a hard conversation. It's also the last time you have to hide it.

choiceRight.label: Keep working the second job quietly
choiceRight.consequenceText: The debt shrinks. So does the time you spend at home.

prompt: You're on a jury for a nonviolent drug case carrying a mandatory sentence you think is unjust, even though the evidence is clear.

choiceLeft.label: Vote guilty per the evidence
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The verdict is legally correct. It doesn't sit right with you.

choiceRight.label: Vote not guilty, on principle
choiceRight.consequenceText: The other jurors are baffled. You don't explain yourself.

prompt: Someone's opened three credit cards in your name. Fixing it will eat months of phone calls and paperwork.

choiceLeft.label: Handle it yourself, methodically
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It takes four months. You get every dollar back.

choiceRight.label: Pay for a service to handle it
choiceRight.consequenceText: It costs you, but it's mostly off your plate within weeks.

prompt: A class action settlement check arrives for a company you're fairly sure is still doing the thing they got sued for.

choiceLeft.label: Cash it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's legally yours. You cash it without much thought.

choiceRight.label: Donate it to a related advocacy group
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's a small gesture. It's also the only one available to you.

prompt: Your father, who left when you were seven, is dying and has asked to see you.

choiceLeft.label: Go see him
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You don't forgive him in that room. You go anyway.

choiceRight.label: Don't go
choiceRight.consequenceText: You don't regret it the way people warned you that you would. Mostly.

prompt: The junior colleague you mentored for years just took credit for your idea in front of the whole department.

choiceLeft.label: Correct the record publicly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The room goes quiet. Everyone knows whose idea it actually was now.

choiceRight.label: Let it go
choiceRight.consequenceText: It happened. You decide not to make it a thing. It stays a thing anyway.

prompt: A franchise opportunity could double your income, if you're willing to take on debt most people wouldn't.

choiceLeft.label: Take the debt, open the franchise
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You sign the papers. The next two years are going to be tight.

choiceRight.label: Pass on it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You watch someone else open one two blocks over, a year later.

prompt: A survey reveals your fence sits two feet onto your neighbor's property. They haven't noticed in twelve years.

choiceLeft.label: Tell them and fix it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They're surprised you brought it up at all. The fence gets moved.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing
choiceRight.consequenceText: The fence stays exactly where it is. You avoid that side of the yard a little.

prompt: You witness a coworker being harassed by a client. Reporting it could cost the company the account, and you your standing with your boss.

choiceLeft.label: Report it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The account is at risk. Your coworker thanks you privately, once.

choiceRight.label: Stay quiet, it's not your call
choiceRight.consequenceText: The account stays. You avoid your coworker's eyes for a while.

prompt: Your stepmother's will leaves everything to her biological children. You're the one who took care of her for the last two years.

choiceLeft.label: Contest the will
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The lawyers drag it out for a year. You get something. The family doesn't survive it intact.

choiceRight.label: Let it stand
choiceRight.consequenceText: You walk away with nothing but the years you gave her. Some days that feels like enough.

prompt: Something you posted years ago has resurfaced. People are demanding a public apology for something you don't actually think was wrong.

choiceLeft.label: Apologize anyway, to make it stop
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It works, mostly. You don't fully mean it, and you know that.

choiceRight.label: Refuse, stand by what you said
choiceRight.consequenceText: It doesn't blow over as fast. You don't regret it, exactly.

prompt: Your child's diagnosis means a specialized school that costs more than you make in a year.

choiceLeft.label: Find a way to pay for it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You take on debt you'll be paying off for a decade. Your kid thrives there.

choiceRight.label: Fight for accommodations at public school instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's an uphill fight with the district, every single semester.

prompt: You discover your company has been underreporting emissions for years. It hasn't visibly hurt anyone yet.

choiceLeft.label: Report it to regulators
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The fine is enormous. Your name gets out eventually, one way or another.

choiceRight.label: Say nothing
choiceRight.consequenceText: Nothing changes, outwardly. You know what you know now.

prompt: Your brother asks for money again. You know exactly what it's for this time.

choiceLeft.label: Give him the money
choiceLeft.consequenceText: He's grateful, briefly. You know you'll be here again soon.

choiceRight.label: Say no, for real this time
choiceRight.consequenceText: He calls you selfish. It's the hardest boundary you've held with him.

prompt: You could retire now on less, or work three more years for real security.

choiceLeft.label: Retire now
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The first Monday morning with nowhere to be feels like a small miracle.

choiceRight.label: Work three more years
choiceRight.consequenceText: The security is real. So is the time you don't get back.

prompt: An unplanned pregnancy, at the worst possible financial moment, changes everything you'd planned.

choiceLeft.label: Rearrange your whole life around it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Nothing goes the way you planned. Most of it turns out fine anyway.

choiceRight.label: Stick to the plan you had
choiceRight.consequenceText: The decision costs you something you don't talk about much.

prompt: A colleague asks you to sign off on an expense report you know is padded.

choiceLeft.label: Refuse to sign it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They're annoyed. They find someone else to sign it instead.

choiceRight.label: Sign it, this once
choiceRight.consequenceText: It goes through fine. You know it won't be the only time they ask.

prompt: The steady job offer comes through the same week as your one real shot at the creative career you gave up on years ago.

choiceLeft.label: Take the steady job
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's the responsible choice. You wonder about the other one more than you expected.

choiceRight.label: Chase the creative shot
choiceRight.consequenceText: It might not work out. For the first time in years, you don't care.

prompt: You haven't seen your elderly neighbor in days. Checking in means possibly finding something you can't unsee.

choiceLeft.label: Go check on them yourself
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You knock. What happens next stays with you either way.

choiceRight.label: Call the authorities to check instead
choiceRight.consequenceText: It's handled by someone else. You still wonder if you should have gone yourself.
